prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: single reusable nine-slice pause menu panel texture for a PSX-style survival game.
Input image: reference image 1 is the game's existing HUD status-icon atlas. Match its coarse dark charcoal / near-black backplates, worn desaturated gray metal rims and 1996-1999 console inventory aesthetic. The objects inside the badges are style references only; do not reproduce them.
Primary request: one perfectly square empty UI panel, facing camera straight-on, centered and filling the entire square image. A restrained worn gunmetal-gray beveled rectangular rim surrounding a nearly black blue-charcoal inset. Thin, simple stepped/chamfered corners like a rectangular counterpart to the HUD medallion rims. Broad flat baked highlight along the top and left, darker bottom and right. Low-resolution pre-rendered PS1 game texture appearance with coarse mottled shading and subtle ordered dithering. Small limited muted gray/olive palette. Keep the center uniformly very dark so live ivory text will read clearly.
Production constraints: border contained within the outer 8 percent of the canvas on every side; corners small and restrained; no ornament or inset objects; middle 84 percent is empty uninterrupted dark charcoal. Full square panel with no margin around it, opaque center and opaque outer edge. No writing, letters, numbers, icons, screws, wood, copper, gold filigree, buttons, modern glossy effects, vignette, floating shadows, gradients or environment. Output only the square panel texture, not a whole menu or screenshot. It will be downsampled and palette reduced locally after generation.
style_references: assets/ui/hud-medallions.png supplied as image reference; match coarse charcoal backplates and worn desaturated gray rims.
compression: Local Pillow: BOX downsample to 64x64, saturation 45%, quantize to 16 colors with Floyd-Steinberg dithering, NEAREST upscale to 128x128, optimized 4-bit indexed PNG. Bevy decodes palette PNGs to RGBA; GPU texture is 64 KiB.
usage: One image handle reused for panel and button nine-slicing, 11px source borders, corner scales multiplied by four to retain existing UI dimensions. Asset-local nearest-neighbor sampling. Live text, focus indicators and controls are rendered separately.
validation: Inline Pillow assertions: 128x128 dimensions, P mode, at most 16 colors, PNG IHDR bit depth 4 / color type 3, uniform 2x2 pixel blocks, central text region RGB channels below 32.

font.atlas_note: Three shared text sizes limit glyph-atlas allocations; Bevy allocates a minimum 512x512 atlas per font size.
